items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1958-Fall
items.q: I heard his name, but I think it was according to Saints. I don't remember.

ctx.x: Well, the friends of the players knew, even the players themselves, they played with these people and all that.
I never remember seeing anything or hearing anything of Black Benny at that time. He was supposed to be a fairly well-known character.

I heard his name, but I think it was according to Saints. I don't remember. But there were players playing places that I would stand on the sidewalk and listen to me and never had an idea who was playing inside. Oh, boy. Jolly, Jolly was not like a lot of people imagine. As far as I was concerned, he didn't do much bragging with me. He would state what he thought, you know. Yeah, well, that's, I remember, as the not bragging.
